hook: Global watchdogs just flagged China and major economies for failing bank safety rules.

sections.voiceover: Global watchdogs just flagged China and major economies for failing bank safety rules.
The Financial Stability Board reviewed 19 global jurisdictions in October 2026. China and Switzerland received materially non-compliant ratings. Which economies passed the audit?
Only 4 economies fully comply with international standards for funding systemic banks.
Argentina and India joined China on the non-compliant list. Australia and the European Banking Union failed too. International regulators exposed severe funding gaps.
Only four nations passed the rigorous global test established by international regulators.
